title: Nyiko Leyi Cinceke Vumundzuku
intro: Emasikwini yo sungula ya vumunhu, moya-xiviri a wu nyikela nyiko hi swikongomelo leswi tengeke. Hambi swi ri tano, mavondzo a ma tumbele endzhutini wa ku amukeriwa. Kuma xitori xa xifaniso lexi lexi ku chava Xikwembu ni makumu ya xona lama khomisaka gome swi nga fiki eka nhlavutelo ya Xikwembu.
clues: A ndzi ri exikarhi ka switukulwana swo sungula swinene swa vanhu.
Ndzi humese gandzelo eka Hosi ya mina, kutani yi amukeriwa hi tintswalo.
Gandzelo ra makwerhu ri ariwile, naswona mavondzo ma n’wi dyisile mbilu.
Ndzi n'wi byerile ndzi ku: ‘Loko wo tshambuluta voko ra wena eka mina leswaku u ndzi dlaya, a ndzi nge tshambuluti voko ra mina ku ku dlaya; hakunene ndzi chava Allah, Hosi ya misava.’
Ndzi ve muhlaseriwa wa xiendlo xo sungula xa ku dlaya emisaveni.
Ngati ya mina yi huwelerile, naswona a ndzi ri mudlawela-ripfumelo wo sungula wa ku pfumala nandzu.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
